chunks: Those who barter unbelief for faith, will not harm God in the least, and the punishment for them will be painful.
ai.seo_question: What happens to those who trade faith for disbelief?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from initial faith to apostasy, emphasizing that God’s sovereignty remains unaffected by human choices. It underscores the concept of *damm al-iman* (sealing of faith) for those who consciously reject truth after accepting it, leading to eternal punishment. The verse serves as a warning against the spiritual decay that occurs when disbelief is actively chosen over conviction.
